rules.name: Banquet of Blood
rules.text: In step 3 of the Aftermath sequence pick up to 3 friendly Vampyre fighters to sit at the table. Each of those fighters earns d6 bonus experience. If you won the battle, each of those fighters earns 2d6 bonus experience instead.

rules.name: Necromantic Study
rules.text: In each Aftermath sequence, pick 1 of the following: Read Forbidden Scrolls – in step 3, your Leader gains 5 bonus experience; Create a Zombie – in step 6, roll a dice. On a 5+, your Leader has successfully created a Zombie from one of the hall's corpses. You can recruit a Zombie to your warband for 0 silver.

rules.name: Trophy Room
rules.text: Each time a Beast or Brute that was taken down by your Leader is killed, your Leader earns 10 bonus experience.

rules.name: A Howl in the Night
rules.text: In step 6 of the Aftermath sequence, roll a dice. On a 6, a Dire Wolf emerges from of the forest. You can recruit a Dire Wolf to your warband for 0 silver.

rules.name: Barrow Offering
rules.text: In step 6 of the aftermath sequence, roll a dice. On a 6, mortals from the City have left an offering. Roll once on the Curiosities table.

rules.name: Immortal Slumber
rules.text: If your Leader is 'Laid to Rest', they are not removed from your warband. Instead they miss the next d3 battles as they slumber. You can pick a Champion to assume command until they return.

rules.name: Dark Harvest
rules.text: In step six of the aftermath sequence, roll a dice. On a 5+, you receive 1 Blackrose Balm.

rules.name: Ossified Remains
rules.text: Reduce the cost of recruiting Skeleton fighters to your warband by 10 silver.

rules.name: Treasure of the Crypt
rules.text: When this upgrade is picked, you can roll once on the Relics table.

rules.name: A Night's Work
rules.text: In step six of the aftermath sequence, you receive 1 Vial of Poison.

rules.name: Circle the Skies Above
rules.text: If a friendly Gargoyle starts the battle in reserve, instead of making a reinforcement roll for them, you can say they are circling the skies above. If you do so, they arrive in the Start of Round step of the next round, before any reinforcement rolls are made. They can be set up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy fighters.

rules.name: Nexus of Dark Magic
rules.text: Each battle, you can ignore the first miscast by a friendly Wizard.
